title: founder-slots-remaining response
description: Response body contract for the public `founder-slots-remaining` edge function. Success (HTTP 200) returns the remaining/total slot counts; every failure (405 or 503) returns a stable error envelope with a machine-readable `error_code`. Every response — success or failure — includes a `request_id` UUID that is also echoed in the `x-request-id` response header.

requestId.description: UUID (lowercase) that correlates the response with server-side structured logs and the `x-request-id` response header.

remaining.description: Founder Lifetime slots still available. `0` means sold out.

error.description: Coarse category retained for back-compat. Clients should branch on `error_code`, not this field.

error_code.description: Stable machine-readable failure reason. See `errorCodeVariants` for the full catalog and semantics.

method_not_allowed.meaning: Request used an HTTP method other than GET, POST, or OPTIONS.
method_not_allowed.clientAction: Fix the call site to use GET.

startup_dependencies_unavailable.meaning: Module dependencies (Supabase client, contract module) failed to import at cold start.
startup_dependencies_unavailable.clientAction: Fall back to the static Founder cap copy; retry after a short delay.

env_missing.meaning: Required environment variables (SUPABASE_URL / SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY) are not configured.
env_missing.clientAction: Fall back to static cap copy; operator must configure the function.

rpc_error.meaning: The `public.founder_lifetime_slots_remaining()` RPC returned a database error.
rpc_error.clientAction: Retry with backoff; fall back to static cap copy on repeated failure.

rpc_invalid_payload.meaning: The RPC returned a value that is not an integer in the range 0..100.
rpc_invalid_payload.clientAction: Retry once; fall back to static cap copy.

handler_unhandled_error.meaning: An unexpected exception escaped the handler's inner try/catch.
handler_unhandled_error.clientAction: Retry with backoff; fall back to static cap copy.

responseHeaders.x-request-id: Same UUID as the body's `request_id`. Exposed via CORS.
